**Location:** On a ledge jutting out from the wall at the very top of the loft area. To get to it, follow these steps:

name: Patches
description:
**How to Begin:** Spare [Patches](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164504) during his boss fight and speak to him after.
**Steps:** 
1. Exhaust all dialogue options with Patches
2. Activate [Patches' Trap Chest](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165137)
3. Travel back to [Murkwater Cave](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164022) and speak with [Patches](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165135)
4. Go to [Scenic Isle](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=166437) and speak with [Patches](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=166734) there
5. Go to the [First Mt. Gelmir Campsite](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165883) Site of Grace and make your way up to [Patches](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=169057)
6. Find the brightly colored stones near the cliff and trigger a cutscene
7. Go to [Volcano Manor](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=164405) and complete the first couple assassination quests for them
8. Speak with [Patches](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=175962) and receive Letter to Patches
9. Go to the [Ruin-Strewn Precipice](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165513) and defeat [Great Horned Tragoth](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=168974)
10. Return and speak with [Patches](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=175962)
11. Reload the area and speak with Patches again who will reward you with the [Magma Whip Candlestick](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=169020)
12. After [Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=167571) has been killed, speak with Patches at his [new location](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=175930) and receive the [Dancer's Castanets](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=175929)
13. Go to [Patches](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=165135)' starting location where he will attack you
14. Spare him again and he will reward you with [Patches' Crouch](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-lands-between?locationIds=176584) and continue to offer his merchant services

name: Dragon Communion Priestess
description:
**How to Begin:** Speak with [Dragon Communion Priestess](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382198).  
**Steps:**  
1. Speak with the Dragon Communion Priestess, and agree to devour Draconic Essence.
2. Defeat [Bayle the Dread](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381971).
3. Return to her; she will be gone, leaving behind [Priestess Heart](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=405579) and [Flowerstone Gavel](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382525).

_Alternate completion:_
1. Speak with [Moore](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=380751), then with [Thiollier](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381018). Make sure to not progress through Shadow Keep, as this causes Thiollier to move. You will receive [Black Syrup](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=384432).
2. Give the syrup to [Thiollier](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381018) to recieve [Thiollier's Concoction](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=543812)
3. After speaking with the Dragon Communion Priestess at least once, return at nighttime and give her the concoction.
4. After defeating Bayle, when you return, she will still be there, offering you [Dragonbolt of Florissax](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=387449) and [Ancient Dragon Florissax Ashes](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=387450) instead.

name: Count Ymir
description:
**How to Begin:** Speak with [Count Ymir  ](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381272)   
**Steps:**
1. Speak with [Count Ymir](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381272), he will tell you to sound a bell after giving you a map which tells you its location and a Hole-Laden Necklace
2. Go to the [Hanging Bell](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382251) and sound the Bell
3. Return to [Ymir](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381272), he will give you second ruins location and Talisman: Beloved Stardust.  
4. Sound the second bell in [Finger Ruins of Dheo](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382345)
5. Return to  [Ymir](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=381272), talk with him and he will give you third ruins map.
6. Reload the area and interact with his throne to reveal a ladder down.
7. Sound the bell in the area below the ladder to be taken to the boss fight: [Mityr, Mother of Fingers](https://mapgenie.io/elden-ring/maps/the-shadow-realm?locationIds=382002), Defeat it and return to the Chapel
8. Approach the Throne and you will be invaded by Jolan, Defeating him summons Ymir as a boss.
